snippet.title: Mom's Hotel _ Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Mom's Hotel is a 30-minute linear horror game. You play as Claire, whose car breaks down in the middle of nowhere, she meets a strange man who takes her to a small old hotel nearby. But soon Claire realizes that the owner of the hotel, Mrs. Charlotte is not an ordinary old lady...
